layout.body:
Subject: Medical appointment
Dear Ms. Patel,
Your appointment at Lakeside Medical Center is scheduled for May 10 at 3:00 P.M. Please arrive 15 minutes early for paperwork. You will be seen by Dr. Liu. Click the link below to confirm. To reschedule or cancel, call us at 756-8793.
Regards,
Brittany Jones

questions.stem: What time should Ms. Patel arrive for her appointment?
questions.analysis: What time should Ms. Patel arrive for her appointment? 原文依据：Your appointment... is scheduled for May 10 at 3:00 P.M. Please arrive 15 minutes early for paperwork. 预约时间为 5 月 10 日下午 3 点，请提前 15 分钟到达办理手续。 (A) 10:00 AM → 错误 (B) 2:45 PM → 正确 (C) 3:00 PM → 错误 (D) 3:15 PM → 错误

questions.stem: How can Ms. Patel cancel her appointment?
questions.analysis: How can Ms. Patel cancel her appointment? 原文依据：To reschedule or cancel, call us at 756-8793.如需改期或取消，请致电 756-8793。 (A) By replying to the e-mail → 错误 (B) By clicking a link → 错误 (C) By calling a phone number → 正确 (D) By sending a text message → 错误
